# pheno-cargo-template

> Cargo.toml scaffold template for new pheno-* Rust crates. Canonical fleet crate layout (empty `[workspace]`, dual MIT/Apache-2.0, `rust-version = '1.78'`, tracing feature flag pattern per ADR-036).

## Quickstart

```bash
# Use as a cargo-generate template (or copy the tree)
cargo generate --git https://github.com/KooshaPari/pheno-cargo-template
```

## Public API

```rust
pheno_cargo_template::crate_name() -> &'static str
```

## Files

- `Cargo.toml`
- `README.md`
- `src/lib.rs`
- `template/`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `llms.txt`
- `WORKLOG.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `LICENSE-MIT`
- `LICENSE-APACHE`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`).
- rustfmt + clippy (`-D warnings`); `#![warn(missing_docs)]` on the
  public API.
- 80% lib coverage gate (ADR-023 Rule 3.1); see `coverage` job in
  `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Standalone crate (empty `[workspace]` table in `Cargo.toml`); not
  a member of the root monorepo workspace.
- WORKLOG.md is the change history (v2.1 schema, 7 cols + `device`).

## See also

- `AGENTS.md` — agent context.
- `WORKLOG.md` — change history (v2.1 schema).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — release notes.
- `LICENSE-MIT` / `LICENSE-APACHE` — dual license.
- Sibling: every other pheno-* Rust crate (this is the template they fork from).
